info.title: @root/web
info.description: Single-slot Root GP2 HTTP API (Marquise vs Eyrie)

factions.description: Faction of each seat. Empty list = open lobby: every player picks an untaken faction when joining.

FactionId.description: mechanicalMarquise and electricEyrie are Rootbotics bots: seated and played by the engine.

BotSettingsByFaction.description: Difficulty and traits per bot faction; a bot left out plays default with no trait.

allOf.description: Open lobby (created with no factions): the faction this player picks. Joining again changes the pick.

rules.description: Law of Root rules that cover this action, most specific first.

JsonObject.description: JSON Schema of the action to send to POST /game/actions.

models.description: Models an AI player may use: the server list, minus providers without an API key.

allOf.description: Open lobby: the faction the AI player takes.

model.description: Model as <provider>:<modelId>, one of GET /game/ai-models. Omitted = the default model.

sequence.description: Rises by one per activity since the server started.

toolName.description: Tool of a toolCall / toolResult, else null.

text.description: Message to the model, its reply, tool input as JSON, tool result or failure reason.

isError.description: True for a failure and for a tool result the tool rejected.

get.summary: List legal actions in plain words
get.description: Each legal action type with its plain name, the Law of Root rules that cover it and its JSON Schema. No legal values: build the action from the rules and the board.

get.summary: List models an AI player may use

post.summary: Seat an AI player in the lobby

patch.summary: Change the model of an AI player (lobby only)

post.summary: Restart the session of an AI player
post.description: Drops what the AI player was doing (thinking or stuck) and starts a fresh session from the current game state. Actions it already took stay. Operator tool: no seat check.

get.summary: Stream what the AI players do
get.description: Server-sent events, one per activity (message to the model, its reply, tool call, tool result, failure): the latest ones first, then live. Shows what an AI player sees and thinks, its hand included. Operator tool: no seat check.

200.description: Event stream; the data of each event is one AiPlayerActivity

delete.summary: Expel a player from the open lobby
delete.description: Frees the seat of a human or AI player; later seats move down one. Host only in online mode. The host seat (0) cannot be expelled.

schema.description: Seat of the player to expel.

parameters.description: Seat of the player to expel.
parameters.name: seat

get.summary: Look up the Law of Root

schema.description: A rule number such as 7.2 (that rule and its sub-rules) or keywords such as "ambush defender".

parameters.description: A rule number such as 7.2 (that rule and its sub-rules) or keywords such as "ambush defender".
parameters.name: query

post.summary: Run a read-only player tool as the seat of the X-Player-Id caller (what an AI player sees)

schema.description: One of: card, clearing, score, workshops, sympathy, decree, preview.

parameters.description: One of: card, clearing, score, workshops, sympathy, decree, preview.
parameters.name: tool

200.description: The answer of the tool; nothing in the game changed
